_seed_doc: Golden seed corpus: SOCIAL/INVESTIGATION archetype. Pure dialogue scene at a checkpoint, no combat. DM spawns 2-3 NPCs across faction Lines so the MCP naming pipeline is well-exercised.

Pure social/investigation scene focused on dialogue and observation.
